At one flicker period (exposure >= 90) the icSpring saturates the white mat and the jaws at the sensor (46 % of pixels at 255 with brightness 0; brightness -70 only greys the clipped areas, which TC saw as glare). It has no gain control, so in this light there is no exposure that is both band-free and unclipped: banding 33 grey levels accepted until the light is flicker-free or the lens gets an ND filter.
